result.summary: The layout is largely sound, but the 'Popular right now' section contains an implausible discount badge and inconsistent favorite-button styling, plus one card image that renders noticeably washed out compared to its siblings.

issues.description: The pizza card in 'Popular right now' shows a discount badge reading '-100%', which implies the order is entirely free and is almost certainly a data/formatting error (or an unbounded discount value).
issues.suggestion: Validate discount values and cap them at a realistic range; display '-100%' only for genuine free items, otherwise render the correct percentage or a 'Free item' label.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently between the two 'Popular right now' cards: the first uses a white circle with a dark outlined heart, the second uses a dark circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent favorite-button treatment across all cards, ideally a semi-transparent dark or white circle with sufficient contrast on any image.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail in the 'Fastest near you' carousel renders on a very light gray background while sibling cards use dark imagery, making the white '15–25 min' badge low contrast and the card look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent image overlay/gradient behind the duration badge so it maintains contrast regardless of image brightness.
